pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometry with smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges. Relative spatial area of patches is greater on the mid-flank, decreasing in size towards the neck and shoulder.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological graph with visible junction nodes at patch vertices. Pixel thickness of the pathways varies, appearing more constricted in regions of high patch density.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a 1D geometric contour with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background, extending from the visible upper neck to the shoulder.
